title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x^2$$ might fit this pattern.

title: Analyzing the Function
text: The function $$f(x)=x^2$$ is a quadratic function. It creates a parabolic shape. Check if the data points in the scatterplot follow a parabolic pattern.

title: Checking the Fit
text: Does the scatterplot show a parabolic pattern that can be modeled by $$f(x)=x^2$$?
